parsed.summary: The proposed patch correctly resolves the issue by making Field.__hash__() immutable, but it may introduce a behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch reduces the hash value to only the creation_counter, which might lead to hash collisions if multiple fields have the same creation_counter. This could potentially break existing behavior or introduce unexpected issues.
